mapper.select: SELECT user_id, profile_img, gender, birth_date, height, update_dt FROM user_profile_tb WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile_tb SET profile_img = #{profileImg}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, height = #{height}, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile_tb(user_id, profile_img, gender, birth_date, height) VALUES (#{userId}, #{profileImg}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{height})
